environment.device: CI emulator, API 36 google_apis x86_64, swiftshader_indirect GPU
environment.build: debug APK (the DevTools socket needs it; Flutter refuses profile mode on emulators)

page.scroll: scrollTop of .cm-scroller stepped every frame at 6 px/ms for 3000 ms from the cursor's view, bouncing at the ends; frames over 32 ms are slow
page.typing: Input.dispatchKeyEvent key presses 60 ms apart at the cursor on the middle line, each timed from its input event to the end of the next frame (bench/input_recorder.ts)
page.open: the page's synchronous work on the doc.open message (window.codeforge.receive, wrapped), and from its arrival to the end of the next painted frame
page.longTasks: PerformanceObserver longtask entries (over 50 ms) between prepare and measure, and during the scroll and typing
page.memory: dumpsys meminfo TOTAL PSS of the app process and every WebView sandboxed renderer, with the file open

typingP95Ms.label: input → frame p95, DevTools keys mid-file
